newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's net polished diamond May exports $405 mln.
newsitem.headline: Israel's net polished diamond May exports $405 mln.

text.p: Net exports of polished diamonds from Israel in May rose 14.5 percent to $405 million against $354 million in May 1996, figures released by the Ministry of Industry and Trade on Sunday showed.
In the first five months of the year net exports of polished diamonds from Israel totalled $1.816 billion against $1.676 billion in the same period last year, a rise of eight percent.

Exports of polished and rough diamonds in May totalled $478 million against $405 million in May last year. In the first five months of the year total diamond exports, polished and rough, amounted $2.246 billion, up 14 percent from the same period in 1996.

The figures revealed that in the first five months of the year net polished exports to Belgium fell by 28 percent to $116 million and exports to Japan fell by 15 percent to $261 million compared with the same period last year.
The United States was Israel's main export market for polished diamonds with net exports in the first five months of the year totalling $853 million, up 21 percent from the same period last year.
